title.zh: 所得税（Sunstar Singapore 私人有限公司依第 13（12）条享有的豁免）命令 2021
title.en: Income Tax (Sunstar Singapore Pte. Ltd. — Section 13(12) Exemption) Order 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (Sunstar Singapore Pte. Ltd. — Section 13(12) Exemption) Order 2021.

2.—(1) Income comprising dividends amounting to $18,249,090 that is received in Singapore by Sunstar Singapore Pte. Ltd. (a company incorporated in Singapore) from Sunstar Marketing Hong Kong Ltd (a company incorporated in Hong Kong) in the basis periods for the years of assessment 2017 to 2019 is exempt from tax.
(2) The exemption in sub-paragraph (1) is subject to the terms and conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 23 July 2021 addressed to Drew & Napier LLC.
